hooks.command: IN=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); [ -n "$SID" ] || exit 0; SOCK=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/nvim-sockets/$SID" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$SOCK" ] || exit 0; nvim --server "$SOCK" --remote-expr "1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; FILE=$(nvim --server "$SOCK" --remote-expr "expand('%:p')" 2>/dev/null); LINE=$(nvim --server "$SOCK" --remote-expr "line('.')" 2>/dev/null); MODE=$(nvim --server "$SOCK" --remote-expr "mode()" 2>/dev/null); jq -nc --arg f "$FILE" --arg l "$LINE" --arg m "$MODE" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:("nvim active buffer — file: \($f), line: \($l), mode: \($m)")}}'

IN=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); [ -n "$SID" ] || exit 0; SOCK=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/nvim-sockets/$SID" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$SOCK" ] || exit 0; nvim --server "$SOCK" --remote-expr "1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; F=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); [ -n "$F" ] && nvim --server "$SOCK" --remote "$F" 2>/dev/null; nvim --server "$SOCK" --remote-send ':checktime<CR>' 2>/dev/null; exit 0
